Interface NativeSerialPort

public interface NativeSerialPort
Native serial-port access through JNA, without jSerialComm I/O.

The key difference from jSerialComm is explicit DTR/RTS control at open time. This prevents ESP32 resets on USB-Serial bridges such as CH340 and CP210x, where DTR/RTS lines are often wired into the auto-reset circuit.

    • open

      void open(String portName, int baudRate, SerialModemLinePolicy modemLinePolicy) throws ConnectionException
      Opens a port at the requested speed using 8N1 and no flow control.
      Parameters:
      portName - system port name such as "COM3", "cu.usbserial-1234", or "ttyUSB0"
      baudRate - port speed, for example 115200
      modemLinePolicy - DTR/RTS policy for the selected adapter
      Throws:
      ConnectionException
